mapper.select: SELECT l.id, b.name AS brand_name, l.model, l.product_type, l.usage_positioning, l.weight_kg, l.image_url, l.source_url, l.release_date, pr.price AS latest_price, c.model AS cpu_model, g.model AS gpu_model, g.gpu_type, m.capacity_gb AS memory_capacity_gb, st.capacity_gb AS storage_capacity_gb, sc.size_inch AS screen_size_inch, sc.resolution AS screen_resolution, sc.refresh_rate_hz FROM shopping_cart cart JOIN laptop l ON l.id = cart.laptop_id JOIN brand b ON b.id = l.brand_id LEFT JOIN cpu_spec c ON c.id = l.cpu_id LEFT JOIN gpu_spec g ON g.id = l.gpu_id LEFT JOIN memory_spec m ON m.id = l.memory_id LEFT JOIN storage_spec st ON st.id = l.storage_id LEFT JOIN screen_spec sc ON sc.id = l.screen_id LEFT JOIN price_record pr ON pr.id = ( SELECT pr2.id FROM price_record pr2 WHERE pr2.laptop_id = l.id ORDER BY pr2.crawled_at DESC, pr2.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY cart.created_at DESC, l.id DESC
